translation.name: Easter Island (Rapa Nui)
translation.summary: Explore the moai statues of Easter Island, Ahu Tongariki, the Rano Raraku volcanic landscape, Anakena Beach and the traditions of Rapa Nui.

translation.body:
Easter Island, also known as Rapa Nui, is a remote Pacific island belonging to Chile. Its monumental carved moai, ceremonial platforms and volcanic landscapes make it an exceptional destination for a journey centred on archaeology, nature and island culture.

The statues invite questions about how they were carved, moved and raised. Many figures stand on ceremonial platforms; others remain near the slopes of Rano Raraku, where numerous unfinished moai can be seen. Island legends and oral traditions add another dimension to the landscape.

At Ahu Tongariki, a long ceremonial platform with moai stands near the ocean. Visits can include volcanic craters and Rapa Nui National Park, as well as Anakena Beach, known for its pale sand and clear water. The crater of Rano Kau contains a freshwater lake.

Beyond the archaeological sites, discover local culture through music and dance, spend time by the Pacific coast and explore the island’s botanical landscapes. Ada Tours can arrange these experiences as a dedicated Easter Island itinerary or as part of a longer journey through Chile.
